offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes to homebuyers, including entry-level, move-up and active-adult buyers. It also develops land and offers mortgage, title and insurance services through affiliates.

primary_products.value: single-family detached homes; attached homes and townhomes; active-adult community homes; residential lots

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title services; homeowners insurance brokerage; land development

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and active-adult homebuyers; B2B: occasional lot and land sales to other builders and developers

end_markets.value: residential housing; new home construction; active-adult communities

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of newly built homes and lots to buyers; service fees: mortgage origination, title and insurance fees from homebuyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys land and materials, uses subcontractors to build homes sold to homebuyers; service provider: land development and financial services for its own communities

geography_served.value: US national: Arizona, California, Colorado, Texas, Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas, Washington, Oregon, Nevada and other Sunbelt and western states

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding, land development and home-related financial services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: model homes and sales centers in its communities; online: website home search and online sales tools; agents / brokers: outside real estate agents who bring buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: zoning, land use, environmental and building codes, mortgage affiliate subject to CFPB and lending rules
